integrity: A direct analytic proof and reproducible simulation are supplied. Simulation is only corroboration; priority is provisionally assessed, independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed integer n>=3 and fixed concentration alpha>0; no uniform n,alpha,threshold regime, no inference for non-Dirichlet normal gaps. The 2015 and 2018 source full texts were not accessible for historical-priority comparison.
title: A universal Pareto tail and Dirichlet shape limit for random tangent polygons
